action.keepAnyway: Keep this recording without analysing it

patient.title: Patient
patient.subtitle: Check that you have the right person before you start.
patient.missingBody: An assessment is always about one person. Choose the patient first, then start recording.

deviceGuide.title: Using the recorder
deviceGuide.subtitle: Nine steps, from switching the recorder on to cleaning it for the next patient.

device.powerOn: Slide the power switch up. The screen lights up.
device.insertCard: Push the memory card into the slot until it stops.
device.placeChest: Hold the round chestpiece flat against the patient's bare skin.
device.pressRecord: Press the button once to start recording.
device.recording: Recording. Keep still and quiet. The patient breathes normally through an open mouth.
device.stopSave: Press the button again to stop. The recording is saved to the card.
device.removeCard: Switch the recorder off first, then take the card out.
device.importToApp: Copy the recordings from the card into the app.
device.clean: Wipe and disinfect the chestpiece before the next patient.

placement.R_UPPER: Position 1 — patient's right upper chest, just below the collarbone.
placement.L_UPPER: Position 2 — patient's left upper chest, just below the collarbone.
placement.R_MIDDLE: Position 3 — patient's right middle chest, level with the nipple line.
placement.L_MIDDLE: Position 4 — patient's left middle chest, level with the nipple line.
placement.R_LOWER: Position 5 — patient's right lower chest, just above the bottom of the ribs.
placement.L_LOWER: Position 6 — patient's left lower chest, just above the bottom of the ribs.

location.title: Choose a position
location.subtitle: Tap a position to record it. Work through 1 to 6 in order.
location.mapAlt: A patient seen from the front, with the six listening positions numbered 1 to 6.
location.rerecordHint: Tapping a recorded position replaces what is stored for it.

placement.title: Position {{number}} — {{name}}
placement.subtitle: Hold the chestpiece here, then record with the device.
placement.imageAlt: Where to hold the chestpiece for position {{number}}.

capture.title: Import the recording
capture.subtitle: Choose the WAV file you recorded at position {{number}}.
capture.hint: Copy the files off the memory card first — that is step 8 of the device guide.

error.empty: That file is empty. It may not have copied across fully — copy it from the memory card again.
error.too-long: That recording is longer than two minutes, which is more than the app can analyse. Record a new one of about 10 to 30 seconds.
error.decode-failed: The app could not read that file. Choose a WAV file recorded by the Ausculta recorder.
error.not-riff: That is not a WAV recording. Choose a .wav file from the recorder's memory card.
error.missing-fmt: That WAV file has no format header, so the app cannot tell how to read it. Copy the original file from the memory card again.
error.missing-data: That WAV file holds no audio. The recording may have been interrupted — record this position again.
error.no-frames: That WAV file is too small to hold any audio. The recording may have been stopped straight away — record this position again.
error.unsupported-format: That WAV file is compressed. The recorder saves uncompressed WAV, so choose the original file rather than a converted copy.
error.unsupported-bit-depth: That file is not 16-bit audio. The recorder saves 16-bit WAV, so choose the original file from the memory card rather than a converted copy.
error.unknown: The app could not read that file. Copy it from the memory card again, or record this position again.

quality.title: Recording check
quality.subtitle: The app checks every recording before it is analysed.
quality.passBody: Nothing in the sound would stop the analysis.
quality.warnTitle: This recording can be analysed, with a warning
quality.warnBody: It is usable, but a better recording would give a more reliable result.
quality.failBody: It will not be sent to the model. Record this position again and import the new file.
quality.exampleAlt: The wrong way on the left, the right way on the right.

flag.silence: Almost no sound was picked up.
flag.clipping: The sound was far too loud and is distorted.
flag.clipping-warn: Parts of the sound are a little too loud.
flag.noise-like: This sounds like background noise rather than breathing.
flag.tonal: One steady tone drowns out everything else.
flag.hf-dominant: The recording is mostly hiss and rustling.

advice.too-short: Record for longer — about 10 to 30 seconds at each position.
advice.silence: Hold the whole rim flat against the chest with light, even pressure.
advice.clipping: Ask the patient to sit still and breathe deeply through an open mouth.
advice.clipping-warn: Ask the patient to sit still and breathe deeply through an open mouth.
advice.dc-offset: The recording can still be used, but have the recorder checked.
advice.noise-like: Record in a quiet room. Switch off fans and ask others not to talk.
advice.tonal: Ask the patient to sit still and breathe deeply through an open mouth.
advice.hf-dominant: Place the chestpiece directly on bare skin. Move clothing out of the way first.

analysis.title: Analysing the recording
analysis.body: Listening through the recording one second at a time. On a phone this can take several seconds.
analysis.keepOpen: Keep the app open until it finishes.

verdict.suggestive: Sound pattern suggestive of {{condition}} — please consult a physician.
verdict.uncertain: Result uncertain. The breathing sounds in this recording did not match any one pattern clearly enough to report.
verdict.tooFewWindows: Result uncertain. Too little of this recording was loud enough to analyse.
verdict.insufficientQuality: This recording could not be used, so nothing was analysed.
verdict.modelNotConnected: The analysis model is not installed on this device, so this recording has not been analysed.
verdict.fallback: This recording produced no result that can be shown.

result.title: Result
result.noAbnormalityCaveat: This does not rule out illness.
result.uncertainHelp: Record this position again in a quieter moment, holding the chestpiece flat against bare skin.
result.insufficientHelp: Nothing reached the model, so there is no result to show.
result.notConnectedTitle: The analysis model is not installed
result.notConnectedBody: The recording has been saved and can be analysed later, once the model is installed on this device. Nothing about this patient's lungs has been assessed.
result.errorBody: The recording was saved, but the app could not turn the analysis into a result. Show this to whoever supports the device.
result.audioUnsupported: This device cannot play the recording back.
result.reviewNote: A practitioner reviews every recording. Nothing here is a conclusion on its own.

next.title: Position saved
next.submitHint: You can send the assessment for review at any point. Six positions give a practitioner the fullest picture.
next.needsOne: Record at least one position before sending the assessment for review.

submitted.title: Sent for review
submitted.body: The assessment is saved on this device and is waiting for a practitioner to review it.

error.saveFailed: The recording could not be saved on this device. Try again.
error.submitFailed: The assessment could not be sent for review. Try again.
error.notFound: That assessment is no longer on this device.
